# Conscious
AI journaling/reflection platform for students and tutors. Prototype: lexicon mood scoring, reflective prompts, history & summary. LLM backend planned.
Usage: `python app.py "I felt great today"`; `python app.py summary`
Also: `python app.py trend` shows 7-entry mood average.

## CivicHack: Conscious for community
Private journaling reflector that tracks mood trends locally (no cloud). Useful for students and tutors in San Jose.
Run: python3 app.py

## Agents Weekend: reflection agent
`python app.py agent` reads recent check-ins, labels the trend as own check-ins vs inferred, and suggests one action.
